note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997). The original is in English; only the alate is recorded, and no soldier or worker is described. Synonymy citations, distribution records and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown; antennae, pronotum and posterior parts of meso- and metanotum brown; T-shaped marking on pronotum and postclypeus and humeral spots yellowish brown; abdominal tergites brown. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length with wings 14.0–15.0 mm, without wings 9.0–10.0 mm. Head capsule round (1.18–1.29 mm to base of mandibles, 1.38–1.49 mm wide including compound eyes). Fontanelle indistinct. Compound eyes round, medium-sized, protruding (maximum diameter 0.29–0.34 mm); distance to the lower margin of the head about 1/2 of their diameter (eye to lower head margin 0.15–0.18 mm). Ocellus small, elliptical (long diameter 0.13–0.18 mm, short diameter 0.09–0.13 mm); separated from compound eye by about its long diameter (eye–ocellus distance 0.13–0.16 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 about half of segment 2, shortest. Postclypeus strongly inflated; length nearly 1/2 of its width. Pronotum subhemispherical, slightly wider than the head including compound eyes (0.92–0.99 mm long, maximum width 1.40–1.50 mm); anterior margin straight, slightly raised and with a weak notch; posterior margin slightly incurved. Wings transparent, colourless; forewing about 11.0–11.9 mm long.
